message.reasoning:
The user says "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. But docker start is used to start containers, not the Docker service itself. To start Docker Desktop or Docker Engine on Windows, you typically use services or Docker Desktop UI. There's also `docker-machine start` for Docker Machine. Or you can start the Docker service via `net start com.docker.service`. Or if using Docker Desktop, you might need to launch Docker Desktop app.

But the user wants to "start Docker on window using docker start." That seems ambiguous. They might want to start Docker Desktop or Docker Engine. We can interpret as they want to start the Docker service. So we can provide a command: `net start com.docker.service`. Or if using Docker Desktop, you can start it via launching the application. But we can give a command to start the Docker service.

We have a tool to execute commands on Windows. We can call the function with command: `net start com.docker.service`. But we should check if the user wants to start Docker Desktop. If they want to start Docker Desktop, we can run `Start-Process -FilePath "C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe"`. But the simplest is to start the service.

Thus we will call the function with command: `net start com.docker.service`.
